title: Ask Suggest Priority Batching T2 HowTo
desc: T2 domain tier. Step-by-step: batch GPT ranking, concurrent per-item queries, timeout handling, pipeline health check, Opus delegation.
steps: wkappbot suggest list (one page). Merge duplicates: wkappbot suggest merge --all-matching PATTERN --dry-run first.
Batch rank via GPT --timeout 20s with full list. Fire-and-forget background. Continue analysis in parallel.
Per-item queries (concurrent): fire all at once with ts+title+root-cause question. STOP. Wait for responses.
STOP after firing queries. Do NOT use Claude tokens while GPT runs. Resume ONLY after responses or 20s timeout.
NO-RESPONSE: FindAllPrompts:0 in log = Chrome AI tab closed. Re-open with --new-tab. File BUG-AUTO.
After responses: brief Opus with ts+title+result+fix-path. Agent(model:opus, prompt:fix+resolve).
PIPELINE HEALTH first: wkappbot cdp ping --sync --timeout 20s. Broken = BUG-AUTO + fallback to codebase analysis.
Failure fallback: no response in 20s = continue with codebase analysis. Never block indefinitely.
author: claude
